summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Arroba MVP platform - digital agency marketplace with React + FastAPI + MongoDB. Tested both backend APIs and frontend UI functionality.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 401 'Invalid session' when using JWT token from registration
minor_bugs.impact: Protected endpoint authentication not working with JWT tokens
minor_bugs.details: Backend uses session-based auth with cookies, but registration returns JWT token. Session token should be used instead.

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, stats, and CTAs
Marketplace page loads with filters and empty state display
Register page shows role selection (Comprador, Vendedor, Advisor)
Login page loads with email/password form and Google OAuth option
User login flow returns 401 for invalid credentials (expected)
All navigation and UI interactions functional
Filter dropdowns and form controls operational
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session-based authentication for protected endpoints. The /api/auth/me endpoint should work with the session token from registration response, not just JWT tokens.
